title: Bounded constructibility on affine source opens
statement: Fix a universe u, a prime ell and a field k of positive characteristic different from ell. All schemes are separated finite-type k-schemes in u. Let Lambda be a commutative condensed ring with a certificate IsEllAdicCoefficient ell Lambda, allowing continuous finite extensions, integral valuation rings with torsion, and the finite-subextension-valued algebraic closure [def-sfb-adic-coefficient-certificate]. Write B_T for the full bounded constructible subcategory of the ordinary unbounded derived category of internal Lambda_T-module objects [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible; sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Let g:Z -> Y be proper, and F_g the canonical restriction of Rg_* to the localizing hulls Loc(B_Z) -> Loc(B_Y), with coproduct indices in u+1 [lem-sfb-adic-proper-localizing-pushforward; def-sfb-bounded-constructible-localizing-closure]. For every supplied adjunction F_g left-adjoint G, K in B_Y, and open immersion j:U -> Z with U affine, exact derived pullback j*(G K) lies in B_U.

proof.text: Compactify j;g with open part j and proper part g. Obtain L in B_U and the compact-support counit that represents Hom(-,K) on bounded constructible tests.

The exact open extension and pullback preserve the localizing hulls: bounded constructible preservation holds on generators, and the left-adjoint coproduct and triangulated properties extend it by the hull universal property.

Compose the supplied adjunction with the open adjunction to obtain E_M:Hom(R(j;g)!M,K) ~= Hom(M,j*GK) on the hull. Transpose the counit to t:L -> j*GK. Naturality proves that postcomposition by t is bijective for every bounded constructible test.

The cone of t is right orthogonal to the bounded constructible generators, including their shifts. The source and target are in the hull, hence in its double orthogonal: the colocal property is triangulated and stable under coproducts. Mathlib ObjectProperty.isColocal_trW then shows t is an isomorphism. Transfer bounded constructibility across it.

theorem affine_restriction_boundedConstructible
    (G : (boundedConstructibleLocalizingClosure Λ Y.left).FullSubcategory ⥤
      (boundedConstructibleLocalizingClosure Λ Z.left).FullSubcategory)
    (adj : ellAdicLocalizingLowerStar Λ ℓ g hΛ ⊣ G)
    (K : (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ Y.left)).FullSubcategory)
    {U : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType U.hom] [QuasiCompact U.hom] [IsSeparated U.hom]
    [IsAffine U.left] (j : U ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j.left] :
    boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ U.left)
      (D((j.left)^*⟦Λ⟧).obj
        (G.obj ((boundedConstructibleToLocalizing Λ Y.left).obj K)).obj)
